test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following sentence the underlined part contains an error. Alternatives to the underlined part are given as options. Select the correct alternative.

The new almirah is__ big__ than this one.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect comparative form of the adjective "**big**."
 
• Comparative adjectives are used to compare differences between the two objects they modify (larger, smaller, faster, higher).
 
• The correct comparative form of "**big**" is "**bigger**."
 
• Thus, the sentence should be corrected to "**bigger than this one**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The new almirah is **bigger than this one**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "more big"** is incorrect because "big" is a one-syllable adjective, and for one-syllable adjectives, we add "-er" to make the comparative form.
 
• **Option 3: "biggest"** is incorrect because "biggest" is the superlative form, used to compare more than two items or people.
 
• **Option 4: "more bigger"** is incorrect because it is a double comparative, which is grammatically incorrect.
